name: Correct a complex flavour balance
short_description: Diagnose and correct salt, acidity, sweetness, bitterness, or aroma across three unfamiliar dishes.
self_assessment: I can correct the flavour balance of three unfamiliar dishes without help and explain each adjustment.
description: Diagnose and correct salt, acidity, sweetness, bitterness, or aroma across three unfamiliar dishes. The stated threshold defines a repeatable capability that can be demonstrated in a fresh but ordinary context. It covers preparation, execution, and checking the result within the named conditions. It excludes a one-off task or dependence on a particular product, institution, culture, or living arrangement, so the holder can assess and retain it as a transferable skill.
examples: Adjust three dishes after blind tasting
